node.statement: The left Q-action is close to the identity on S_{Q,R}: since Y=Co_{Q,R}(Y), the compression estimate gives ||Y-Q(YR)||<=C_dot*e*||Y||. Applying Q, then using Q^2=Q+O(delta), the epsilon-associator axiom, and the uniform projection bounds, yields ||QY-Y||<=C_QY*e*||Y|| with universal C_QY.
